meta.title: The Case for a Right to Grow

paragraphs.text: The weakening of the human connection to nature might be good for economic growth but is bad for people. A tipping point was reached in 2020 when human-made materials—such as steel, concrete and plastic—were found to weigh more than all life on Earth. Continuing to grow concrete forests rather than real ones is shortsighted. Simply being in the nearest wood has such health benefits that the Woodland Trust successfully lobbied for it to be prescribed by doctors.

sentences.text: The weakening of the human connection to nature might be good for economic growth but is bad for people.

analysis.translationLiteral: 人与自然的联系被削弱，也许对经济增长是好事，但对人却是坏事。
analysis.translationNatural: 人和自然越走越远，经济账上或许划算，可对人本身没好处。
analysis.structMarkup: 【The weakening of the human connection to nature】 _might be good for economic growth_ _but is bad for people_.
analysis.structureSummary: 主系表（两个并列表语，由 but 连接）+ 名词化短语作主语

components.part: The weakening of the human connection to nature
components.note: 核心词 weakening；of 短语一层套一层，把「削弱」限定在「人与自然的联系」上

components.part: might be good for economic growth
components.note: 情态动词 might 表让步式承认；be good for 意为「对……有益」
but 连接第二个并列系表，转折落到「对人有害」，but 后承前省略主语

clauses: 本句是简单句，没有从句；主干为「主系表（两个并列表语，由 but 连接）+ 名词化短语作主语」。

phrases.meaning: 好的；有益的 / 好处（不可数）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：good at（擅长）/ good for（对……有益）/ well（副词，身体好）。常见搭配：be good at / good for。
phrases.example: A rich social life is good for health. 丰富社交生活有益健康。

phrases.meaning: 经济的、经济上的、经济学的；合算的、有利可图的
phrases.usage: 注意区分：economic（经济上的、与经济有关的，如 economic growth/policy）/ economical（节约的、省钱的，= thrifty，如 an economical car）/ economics（经济学）/ economy（经济；节约）/ economist（经济学家）。
phrases.example: The weakening of the human connection to nature might be good for economic growth but is bad for people. 人和自然越走越远，经济账上或许划算，可对人本身没好处。

phrases.meaning: 增长、生长（不可数）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：growth（增长）/ grow（生长）/ grow up（长大）。常见搭配：economic growth / growth in。
phrases.example: Growth in screen use is clear. 屏幕使用的增长很明显。

pitfalls: 注意区分：good at（擅长）/ good for（对……有益）/ well（副词，身体好）。
注意区分：economic（经济上的、与经济有关的，如 economic growth/policy）/ economical（节约的、省钱的，= thrifty，如 an economical car）/ economics（经济学）/ economy（经济；节约）/ economist（经济学家）。
注意区分：growth（增长）/ grow（生长）/ grow up（长大）。
analysis.paragraphRole: 开篇即用「让步 + 转折」亮出全文立场「疏远自然得不偿失」，正是第 46 题要抓的主旨。

sentences.text: A tipping point was reached in 2020 when human-made materials—such as steel, concrete and plastic—were found to weigh more than all life on Earth.

analysis.translationLiteral: 一个临界点在 2020 年被达到，当时人造材料——比如钢、混凝土和塑料——被发现比地球上所有生命加起来还重。
analysis.translationNatural: 2020 年出了个标志性节点：钢、水泥、塑料这些人造物，总重量首次超过地球上全部生物。
analysis.structMarkup: 【A tipping point】 _was reached_ (in 2020) {when human-made materials—such as steel, concrete and plastic—were found to weigh more than all life on Earth}.
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓（被动语态）+ 时间状语从句（when 引导，含破折号插入语与比较结构）

components.note: tipping point 意为「临界点、转折关头」
一般过去时被动；reach a tipping point 的被动式
时间点，与从句内容对应

components.part: when human-made materials—such as steel, concrete and plastic—were found to weigh more than all life on Earth
components.note: when 引导；破折号间 such as 是插入举例；were found to weigh 为被动 + 不定式，more than 引出比较对象

clauses: 状语从句「when human-made materials—such as steel, concrete and plastic—were fou」：when 引导；破折号间 such as 是插入举例；were found to weigh 为被动 + 不定式，more than 引出比较对象
本句含比较结构（比较级 + than），than 后是被比较对象。
关系词引导定语从句，修饰前面的先行词；从句内部用陈述语序。

phrases.meaning: 例如
phrases.usage: 后接名词性成分列举，不能独立成句。
phrases.example: Sports such as running are popular. 像跑步这类运动很受欢迎。

phrases.meaning: 观点、要点（可数）；分数 / 指出（point out）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：point out（指出）/ point to（表明）/ the point is（关键是）。常见搭配：the point is / point out。
phrases.example: The point is not to blame parents. 重点不是责怪家长。

phrases.meaning: 到达、抵达、达到；伸手够到、联系上；范围、可及之处（reach 的过去式/过去分词形式）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：reached（过去式/过去分词）/ reach（原形）。
phrases.example: A tipping point was reached in 2020 when human-made materials—such as steel, concrete and plastic—were found to weigh more than all life on Earth. 2020 年出了个标志性节点：钢、水泥、塑料这些人造物，总重量首次超过地球上全部生物。

pitfalls: such as 用于举例，for example 常作插入语，位置不同。
比较级 + than 引出比较对象；两者比较用比较级，三者以上用最高级。
定语从句中关系词已充当成分，从句里不要再重复该代词。
被动语态的过去分词不能误写成过去式；不及物动词没有被动。
analysis.paragraphRole: 用人造物超过生物总重的硬数据，把「疏远自然」写成可量化的事实，为第 46 题提供论据。

sentences.text: Continuing to grow concrete forests rather than real ones is shortsighted.

analysis.translationLiteral: 继续去种混凝土森林而不是真正的森林，是目光短浅的。
analysis.translationNatural: 一味盖「水泥森林」而不种真树，太短视了。
analysis.structMarkup: 【Continuing to grow concrete forests rather than real ones】 _is shortsighted_.
analysis.structureSummary: 动名词短语作主语 + 主系表

components.part: Continuing to grow concrete forests rather than real ones
components.note: 动名词短语作主语，谓语用单数 is；concrete forests 是比喻，ones 替代 forests 避免重复
rather than 表取舍，把「水泥森林」与「真森林」对立
系表结构；shortsighted 意为「目光短浅的」，是作者明说的价值判断

clauses: be + 过去分词构成被动语态，主语是动作的承受者。
含转折/取舍副词，用来修正或替代前一句的说法。

phrases.meaning: 而不是
phrases.usage: 连接并列成分，前后形式要一致；后接动词时常用原形。
phrases.example: I'd walk rather than wait. 我宁愿走路也不等。

phrases.meaning: 继续（continue to do / continue doing）（continue 的现在分词/动名词形式）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：continuing（现在分词/动名词）/ continue（原形）。
phrases.example: Continuing to grow concrete forests rather than real ones is shortsighted. 一味盖「水泥森林」而不种真树，太短视了。

phrases.meaning: 生长、增长（不及物）；种植（及物）；变得
phrases.usage: 注意区分：grow（生长/种植）/ grow up（长大）/ increase（增加）。常见搭配：grow crops / grow up。
phrases.example: They grow crops for export. 他们种植出口作物。

pitfalls: rather than 连接的两个成分词性要平行。
被动语态的过去分词不能误写成过去式；不及物动词没有被动。
instead 是副词，不能直接连接两个名词；instead of 才是介词短语。
analysis.paragraphRole: 把上句的数据收成一句判断，点明「重建设轻自然」不可取，呼应第 46 题的 unwise。

sentences.text: Simply being in the nearest wood has such health benefits that the Woodland Trust successfully lobbied for it to be prescribed by doctors.

analysis.translationLiteral: 仅仅是待在最近的树林里就有这样的健康益处，以至于林地信托成功游说让它被医生开进处方。
analysis.translationNatural: 哪怕只是去附近林子待待，好处都大到让「林地信托」推动医生把它写进处方。
analysis.structMarkup: 【Simply being in the nearest wood】 _has such health benefits_ {that the Woodland Trust successfully lobbied for it to be prescribed by doctors}.
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓宾 + such...that 结果状语从句（含不定式被动）

components.part: Simply being in the nearest wood
components.note: 动名词短语作主语，谓语用单数 has；Simply 强调「不费事、只要待着」
such 与后面 that 呼应，先立「益处之大」

components.part: that the Woodland Trust successfully lobbied for it to be prescribed by doctors
components.note: that 引导结果状语从句；lobby for...to be done 意为「游说使……被……」

clauses: 状语从句「that the Woodland Trust successfully lobbied for it to be prescribed b」：that 引导结果状语从句；lobby for...to be done 意为「游说使……被……」
be + 过去分词构成被动语态，主语是动作的承受者。

phrases.meaning: 仅仅、只不过；简单地
phrases.usage: 注意区分：simply（仅仅/简单地）/ simple（简单的）/ simplistic（过于简化的）。常见搭配：simply because / quite simply。
phrases.example: Simply feeling something is right is subjective. 仅仅感觉某事对，是主观的。

phrases.meaning: 在…附近、接近、临近；近的、不远的；几乎、差不多（near 的最高级形式）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：nearest（最高级）/ near（原形）。
phrases.example: Simply being in the nearest wood has such health benefits that the Woodland Trust successfully lobbied for it to be prescribed by doctors. 哪怕只是去附近林子待待，好处都大到让「林地信托」推动医生把它写进处方。

phrases.meaning: 健康；医疗、卫生
phrases.usage: 注意区分：health（名词）/ healthy（形容词）。常见搭配：mental health / public health。
phrases.example: Social ties affect health. 社会联系影响健康。

pitfalls: 被动语态的过去分词不能误写成过去式；不及物动词没有被动。
注意区分：simply（仅仅/简单地）/ simple（简单的）/ simplistic（过于简化的）。
注意区分：nearest（最高级）/ near（原形）。
analysis.paragraphRole: 用「医生可开处方」这一具体例证把自然的健康价值顶到最高，支撑首段立场。

paragraphs.text: Yet slipping from popular culture is the wonder and beauty of the natural world. For every three nature-related words in hit songs of the 1950s, researchers found, there was only slightly more than one 50 years later. It is not a moment too soon that teenagers will be able to take a natural history test, given that for decades children have been able to name more video game characters than wildlife species.

sentences.text: Yet slipping from popular culture is the wonder and beauty of the natural world.

analysis.translationLiteral: 然而正从流行文化中滑落出去的，是自然界的奇妙与美。
analysis.translationNatural: 可另一头，大自然的神奇与美，正悄悄从流行文化里退场。
analysis.structMarkup: (Yet) ~slipping from popular culture~ _is_ 【the wonder and beauty of the natural world】.
analysis.structureSummary: 倒装句（现在分词短语作表语提前 + 主系表，主语后置）

components.note: 转折，从「身体健康」转到「文化记忆」的流失
现在分词短语提前构成倒装，正常语序是 the wonder and beauty... is slipping...
连接提前的表语与后置主语

components.part: the wonder and beauty of the natural world
components.note: 两个抽象名词并列，是真正主语，因倒装落在系动词后

clauses: 本句是简单句，没有从句；主干为「倒装句（现在分词短语作表语提前 + 主系表，主语后置）」。

phrases.meaning: 想知道、纳闷；惊奇
phrases.usage: 常见搭配：wonder why / wonder about。
phrases.example: I wonder why he left. 我想知道他为什么走了。

phrases.meaning: 世界；领域；世人
phrases.usage: 注意区分：world（世界）/ word（单词）读音与拼写易混。常见搭配：around the world / the world of work。
phrases.example: The idea spread around the world. 这个想法传遍世界。

pitfalls: 注意区分：yet（尚/然而）/ already（已经）/ but（但是）。
注意区分：world（世界）/ word（单词）读音与拼写易混。
analysis.paragraphRole: 用倒装把「正在流失」放到句首制造失落感，开启第二段「流行文化离自然越来越远」，对应第 47 题。

sentences.text: For every three nature-related words in hit songs of the 1950s, researchers found, there was only slightly more than one 50 years later.

analysis.translationLiteral: 对于 1950 年代热门歌曲里每三个与自然相关的词，研究者发现，50 年后只有略多于一个。
analysis.translationNatural: 研究者对比发现：五十年代金曲里每出现三个自然词，五十年后只剩一个出头。
analysis.structMarkup: (For every three nature-related words in hit songs of the 1950s), (researchers found), _there was_ 【only slightly more than one 50 years later】.
analysis.structureSummary: 介词短语作状语 + 插入语 + there be 句型（含比例比较）

components.part: For every three nature-related words in hit songs of the 1950s
components.note: For every... 表比例基准；nature-related 是「名词-过去分词」复合形容词
报道插入语，前后逗号隔开，说明数据出处
there be 句型，真正主语在后面

components.part: only slightly more than one 50 years later
components.note: 省略了 nature-related words；slightly 修饰 more than，强调降幅之大

clauses: There be 句型中 there 是引导词，真正的主语在 be 之后，谓语与之一致。
本句含比较结构（比较级 + than），than 后是被比较对象。

phrases.meaning: 单词、话语（word 的复数）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：in other words（换句话说）/ in a word（简言之）/ word（单词）。常见搭配：in other words / in a word。
phrases.example: In other words, the more we believe in effort... 换句话说，我们越相信努力……

phrases.meaning: find 的过去式与过去分词（发现）；另作独立动词「创建、创办」
phrases.usage: 注意区分：found（find 的过去式）/ find（原形）/ founded（创建，独立动词的过去式）。常见搭配：found that... / be found to be。
phrases.example: Researchers found a clear link. 研究者发现了明确的关联。

phrases.meaning: 年、年份；岁数、年纪（year 的复数）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：year（年，可数）/ for years（好多年，与完成时连用）/ in a year's time（一年后）/ a five-year-old（复合词中 year 不用复数）/ ear（耳朵，拼写易混）。
phrases.example: For every three nature-related words in hit songs of the 1950s, researchers found, there was only slightly more than one 50 years later. 研究者对比发现：五十年代金曲里每出现三个自然词，五十年后只剩一个出头。

pitfalls: There be 句型谓语的单复数跟 be 后面的名词走。
比较级 + than 引出比较对象；两者比较用比较级，三者以上用最高级。
analysis.paragraphRole: 用「三比一」的量化对比坐实「流行文化与自然脱节」，是第 47 题的直接证据。

sentences.text: It is not a moment too soon that teenagers will be able to take a natural history test, given that for decades children have been able to name more video game characters than wildlife species.

analysis.translationLiteral: 青少年将能参加自然史测验，这并非一刻太早，鉴于几十年来孩子们能叫出更多电子游戏角色而非野生物种。
analysis.translationNatural: 让孩子考考自然常识，真是一点都不早——毕竟几十年来，他们认得的游戏人物比野生动植物还多。
analysis.structMarkup: 【It】 _is not a moment too soon_ {that teenagers will be able to take a natural history test}, {given that for decades children have been able to name more video game characters than wildlife species}.
analysis.structureSummary: it 形式主语 + 主系表 + 主语从句（that 引导）+ 原因状语从句（given that 引导，含比较结构）

components.note: 形式主语，真正主语是后面的 that 从句

components.part: is not a moment too soon
components.note: 固定表达 not a moment too soon 意为「一点也不早、早该如此」

components.part: that teenagers will be able to take a natural history test
components.note: that 引导，是 it 所指的真正内容

components.part: given that for decades children have been able to name more video game characters than wildlife species
components.note: given that 意为「鉴于」；more...than 比较两类能叫出名字的对象

clauses: 主语从句「that teenagers will be able to take a natural history test」：that 引导，是 it 所指的真正内容
状语从句「given that for decades children have been able to name more video game」：given that 意为「鉴于」；more...than 比较两类能叫出名字的对象
本句含比较结构（比较级 + than），than 后是被比较对象。

phrases.meaning: 能够
phrases.usage: 可用于多种时态，弥补 can 没有不定式的缺陷。
phrases.example: She was able to finish it. 她当时能完成。

phrases.meaning: 不久、很快
phrases.usage: 注意区分：soon（不久）/ early（早）/ quickly（快）。常见搭配：as soon as / soon after。
phrases.example: He was retired soon after. 他不久后就退役了。

phrases.meaning: 能够的（be able to do）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：be able to（能够）/ can（情态动词，不能与 will 连用）/ ability（名词）。常见搭配：be able to do / able to。
phrases.example: They are able to delete the posts. 他们能够删除这些帖子。

pitfalls: can 没有不定式，需要时用 be able to。
比较级 + than 引出比较对象；两者比较用比较级，三者以上用最高级。
现在完成时不能与明确的过去时间点（如 yesterday、in 2020）连用。
analysis.paragraphRole: 用「认得游戏角色多于物种」的反差把文化脱节推到教育对策上，呼应第 47 题并引出下段的 right to grow。

paragraphs.text: Part of remedying this social disease would be for parliament to pass a "right to grow" law, allowing anyone to turn underused public spaces into vegetable and fruit gardens. The idea is for people to get back in touch with the soil—while producing food sustainably.

sentences.text: Part of remedying this social disease would be for parliament to pass a "right to grow" law, allowing anyone to turn underused public spaces into vegetable and fruit gardens.

analysis.translationLiteral: 补救这一社会病症的一部分，会是让议会通过一项「种植权」法律，允许任何人把未被充分利用的公共空间变成蔬菜与水果园。
analysis.translationNatural: 想治这毛病，办法之一是由议会立个「种植权」法：谁都能把闲置的公共地块改成菜园果园。
analysis.structMarkup: 【Part of remedying this social disease】 _would be_ ~for parliament to pass a "right to grow" law~, (allowing anyone to turn underused public spaces into vegetable and fruit gardens).
analysis.structureSummary: 主系表（表语为 for...to do 不定式复合结构）+ 现在分词短语作结果状语

components.part: Part of remedying this social disease
components.note: 动名词 remedying 作 of 的宾语；this social disease 回指上段的文化脱节
情态 would 表建议性推断，不是单纯的「将会」

components.part: for parliament to pass a "right to grow" law
components.note: for sb to do 是不定式复合结构，for 引出逻辑主语 parliament

components.part: allowing anyone to turn underused public spaces into vegetable and fruit gardens
components.note: 现在分词作结果／伴随；turn...into... 为固定搭配

clauses: 逗号后的现在分词短语作伴随状语或补充说明，逻辑主语与主句主语一致。
本句主干为「主系表（表语为 for...to do 不定式复合结构）+ 现在分词短语作结果状语」，先找限定动词再切分修饰成分。

phrases.meaning: 疾病（可数/不可数）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：disease（疾病）/ illness（生病状态）/ decease（死亡，正式）。常见搭配：bone disease / heart disease。
phrases.example: Red Rum had a serious bone disease. 「红朗姆」有严重的骨病。

phrases.meaning: 生长、增长（不及物）；种植（及物）；变得
phrases.usage: 注意区分：grow（生长/种植）/ grow up（长大）/ increase（增加）。常见搭配：grow crops / grow up。
phrases.example: They grow crops for export. 他们种植出口作物。

phrases.meaning: 允许、准许；使能够、让…得以；留出（时间/钱）（allow 的现在分词/动名词形式）

paragraphs.text: Apart from the urgent task of providing more healthy nutrients to those who increasingly can't afford them, publicly accessible fruit and vegetable gardens connect what we eat to where it comes from—the means of production, if you will. They can make unlovely spaces lovely, and marry use and beauty as well as help promote a sense of community. Plants are also, of course, our first defence against species loss and climate change. Such planting is a small step for humanity—in the right direction.

analysis.translationNatural: 公共菜果园除了给吃不起的人补营养，还让人看清：嘴里的食物到底打哪儿来、怎么种出来的。

questions.stem: What does the author want to emphasise in the first paragraph?

options.text: The year 2020 was a big turning point in human history.
Economic growth benefits people little in the long run.
It is unwise to weaken the human connection to nature.
It is harmful to mankind to use human-made materials.

questions.stem: What did researchers find about popular culture?

options.text: It is increasingly detached from the natural world.
It is filled with all kinds of video game characters.
It is especially appealing to the taste of teenagers.
It is still impacted by the hit songs of the 1950s.

questions.stem: What does the author propose people do?

options.text: Take measures to ensure sustainable food development.
Reconnect with nature through the right to grow.
Stand by the parliament in fighting social diseases.
Cover public spaces with fruit trees and vegetable plants.

questions.stem: What do we learn from the passage about vegetable planting?

options.text: It all started in 1649 in Southern England.
It is protected by US government regulations.
It has long been used to increase food supply and improve urban landscape.
It has been popularised worldwide with the increasing influence of social media.

questions.stem: What can publicly accessible fruit and vegetable gardens do apart from their practical functions?

options.text: Raise people's environmental awareness.
Add to the great variety of plant species.
Act as the first defence against natural disasters.
Enhance people's community spirit.

examples: They are able to delete the posts. 他们能够删除这些帖子。
